phases.title: Inventory And Hard Break Plan
acceptance: typed inventory covers every static/global validator, invariant, invalidation, replay, evidence, conflict, cache, undo, and diagnostic path that currently acts without touched graph basis
each inventory row names owner, current authority source, touched graph replacement, deletion action, and removal trigger
rows cannot keep old static/global surfaces; only delete, collapse, certification-only, residue, or query-gap dispositions are allowed
adversarial discovery test rejects an unclassified static validator or invariant entry
deletion test rejects delete/collapse rows that remain exported through ordinary public facade
composition test proves touched Rust files satisfy the workspace line cap or are split
phases.instructions: Build the typed inventory and deletion-ledger harness first. Treat every old static/global authority surface as guilty until it has a touched graph replacement or a mechanically capped disposition. Do not count prose or doc links as coverage.
phases.qa_focus: Inventory coverage, deletion pressure, no keep rows for old authority, facade export audit, line-cap enforcement.

plan: Adversarial constraint: in a hostile 7.3 -> 7.4 -> 7.5 boolean chain over a large B-rep, each operation may touch O(k) topology graph facts while the model, validation registry, evidence ledger, replay catalog, projection cache, and diagnostics can contain O(N) facts where N >> k. Phase 1 breaks if any validator, invariant, invalidation, replay, evidence lookup, conflict, cache, undo, or diagnostic path can still certify, commit, replay, reuse, or explain from static/global breadth, raw rows, operator family, or public facade reachability instead of a typed touched-graph inventory row. The implementation must therefore make every old authority surface mechanically classified before it can remain reachable: no unclassified source under the phase scope, no keep-like disposition for old static/global authority, no delete/collapse row still exported through an ordinary facade, and no touched Rust file over the workspace 400-line cap unless explicitly allowlisted.

authority/proof-bearing types and sealed constructors: inspect and edit crates/worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/{types.rs,registry.rs,report.rs,closeout_*} as the harness precedent, but do not reuse its WorthGraphAuthorityAction::Keep semantics for old authority. First hard break: add a touched-graph inventory vocabulary or tighten the existing one so inventory rows include category, owner, current authority source, touched graph replacement, deletion action, removal trigger, facade export posture, and line-cap source path, with allowed dispositions only delete, collapse, certification-only, residue, and query-gap. Proof boundary: row construction must be sealed through const/build functions that reject empty replacement/removal trigger and reject old static/global surfaces with a keep-like action. Done when compile/test certification can query rows by category and fail on an unclassified validation rule, invariant pack, evidence scan, replay path, cache, undo, or diagnostic source. Blocker/residue only if an inventory target is generated outside Rust and lacks stable source-path identity; then record owner, cap, removal trigger, and a certification-only file-pattern proof.

operator/request intent lowering: inspect crates/worth-topo/src/topology_operators/{mutation_records,declared_mutation_sequence_builder.rs,mutation_sequence.rs,local_rewrites,query_workflow,edge_split_blueprint,loop_reconstruction_blueprint} and Query descriptor surfaces under crates/worth-query/src/runtime/mutation/graph_composition/touch_descriptor. This phase does not build the touched basis, but its inventory must classify every operator-local validator declaration, blueprint proof-obligation row, mutation-record-as-authority shortcut, and local rewrite graph-composition bypass. First hard break: inventory rows for edge/loop blueprint proof_obligation, validator_row, required_phase_2_*, scalar declaration entries, local rewrite composed programs, and query workflow public exports must be forced to delete/collapse/certification-only/residue/query-gap. Proof boundary: ordinary operators may remain only as intent or Query lowering candidates, never as authority rows that can certify validators directly. Done when the adversarial discovery test fails if a new *_validator_lane, proof_obligation, or unclassified scalar operator file appears under topology_operators. Blocker/query-gap only if Query lacks a selector descriptor needed to express a specific topology aspect; name the selector gap instead of adding a Worth-local selector.

Query or runtime selection/admission: inspect crates/worth-query/src/runtime/mutation/graph_composition/{touch_descriptor,obligation}, especially registration/touch_selector.rs, support matrix, dispatch plan/result, and descriptor counters. First hard break: the inventory must distinguish canonical Query touch descriptors/selectors/obligation selection from Worth-local copies, and must mark broad any_graph_touch, collection-only, lifecycle-only, or read-family selectors as residue/query-gap unless backed by exact touched graph replacement. Proof boundary: Query descriptor/selector types are replacement candidates; Worth support reports, adoption matrices, and copied descriptor rows are current-authority sources slated for collapse. Done when inventory rows identify current selector authority, touched graph replacement, and removal trigger for each Query/Worth selection surface, and hostile tests can add a bogus selector/invariant source and fail classification. Query-gap blocker: missing selector expressiveness for topology closure or aspect path must be recorded as a Query-owned row with cap and removal trigger.

validators, invariants, and denial posture: inspect crates/worth-topo/src/validation/{facade.rs,rule_registry.rs,reference_integrity,ownership,loop_wiring,radial_rings,shell_closure,vertex_disks,naming} and Query graph-composition invariant registration/denial modules. Current hard target: TopologyValidator::derived_validation_report and DERIVED_TOPOLOGY_RULE_SPECS run named global/static validator packs over materialized/interpreted whole views. First hard break: inventory every validator family and rule registry row as delete/collapse/certification-only/residue/query-gap, with whole-view validation allowed only as certification-only or capped residue until Phase 5 replaces operator-local legality with touched-closure selection. Proof boundary: rows must name touched graph predicates that will replace each validator family, or a Query gap if the predicate cannot yet be expressed. Done when discovery tests reject adding an unclassified validator module or rule spec, and deletion tests prove delete/collapse validator rows are not exported through ordinary facade as operator legality. Blocker: whole-view validate_interpreted_topology can remain only if marked certification-only with public facade proof that it cannot satisfy ordinary operator closeout.

derived invalidation, dirty propagation, replay, undo, and transaction scope: inspect crates/worth-topo/src/projection/{runtime_boundary,read_views}, crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/{retained_replay_workload,retained_cancellation_chain,planar_boolean_edge_splitting/*replay*,planar_boolean_loop_reconstruction/replay_closeout}, and relevant workload transaction/handoff code. First hard break: classify every projection read-stage validation, materialized/interpreted rebuild, retained replay cache, checkpoint, replay parity row, cancellation chain checkpoint, and transaction/undo-like scope as a derived consumer that must later consume touched graph closure. Proof boundary: replay/undo/invalidation rows cannot use global topology view, retained replay identity, or operation family as replacement authority; replacement must be touched graph closure, receipt digest, and direct-vs-expanded touch counters. Done when the inventory can answer which replay/invalidation sources still act without touched basis and marks them with deletion/collapse or capped residue. Blocker: if no transaction patch/undo authority exists in the current scoped code, record an explicit query/runtime gap rather than inventing undo coverage in prose.

evidence lookup, indexing, receipts, and ledger identity: inspect crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/evidence_ledger, workload_operators/{coplanar_overlap*,mod.rs}, planar boolean event/split/loop evidence modules, and crates/worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/closeout_deletion_evidence.rs. First hard break: classify raw evidence rows, broad stage vectors, string stage links, receipt lookup helpers, and public operator receipt exports as guilty until their replacement is a typed touched-graph keyed lookup product or certification-only fixture. Proof boundary: evidence lookup replacement must include touched graph identity, stage, receipt digest, and counters; raw Vec<WorkloadEvidenceRow>, string identities, and copied receipt fields are deletion targets. Done when deletion-ledger tests reject any delete/collapse evidence row still reachable from workload_platform ordinary public exports, and discovery tests fail on an unclassified evidence_ledger source. Blocker/query-gap: if existing evidence-stage index lacks touched graph digest fields, mark the row as collapse now with Phase 7 removal trigger, not as resolved.

conflict, independence, cache, equivalence, and reuse: inspect Query graph obligation support/selection conflict denials, graph_composition/obligation/registration/*conflict*, spatial retained replay canonical catalog cache (retained_capture_cache), projection/runtime identity reporting, and workload/platform caches or equivalence-style digests. First hard break: classify any cache, retained replay memoization, support matrix conflict, equivalence digest, operator-family reuse, or independence/admission shortcut that can act without touched graph closure. Proof boundary: replacement rows must require touched graph digest plus operating world, validator/evidence set, and conflict posture; pointer identity, row count, world string, operator family, or retained replay cache key cannot satisfy authority. Done when the inventory contains cache/equivalence/conflict category rows and the hostile test can add an unclassified cache/static OnceLock or conflict helper under scope and fail. Blocker: compatible same-relation aspect independence may be query-gap if Query selector/closure cannot express it yet.

public facade, diagnostics, counters, and closeout proof: inspect crates/worth-topo/src/validation/mod.rs, public pub use surfaces in scoped modules, crates/worth-spatial/src/workload_platform/*/mod.rs, crates/worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/{closeout_facade.rs,closeout_report.rs,closeout_counters.rs,closeout_bypass.rs}, and diagnostic modules under split/loop/user_response. First hard break: add facade-export audit rows so any delete/collapse inventory row exported by an ordinary pub use fails closeout; diagnostics may explain inventory status but cannot act as coverage. Proof boundary: counters and closeout reports derive from typed inventory/deletion ledger, not doc links or grep-only prose. Done when the implementer can build tests that add a public export of a delete/collapse row and see failure, and closeout counters report classified/unclassified/deleted/collapsed/residue/query-gap counts by category. Blocker: public diagnostic strings that must remain for UX are certification-only only if they cannot construct or satisfy authority APIs.

hard deletion/collapse of replaced surfaces: inspect all current deletion-target precedents from the prior gate plus the new static/global category surfaces: TopologyValidator ordinary paths, DERIVED_TOPOLOGY_RULE_SPECS, loop/edge blueprint proof-obligation rows, evidence raw scans/stage links, replay parity raw rows, retained caches, and workload operator receipts. First hard break: for every row with delete/collapse, add a mechanical facade/export outcome field and removal trigger; reject rows with blank replacement, blank trigger, or public export still live. Proof boundary: a retained surface is acceptable only as certification-only, capped residue with owner/cap/removal trigger, or named Query gap; do not use residue for publicly exported local ceremony, local guards, raw rows, support wrappers, handoff-only helpers, or proof-obligation surfaces. Done when deletion-ledger acceptance names old surface plus outcome and tests reject delete/collapse rows still exported through normal facades. Blocker: if deletion would require a later touched-basis type from Phase 2, record collapse target and Phase 2 removal trigger, not an open-ended keep.

compile-fail, hostile tests, line-cap, and composition QA: inspect existing test placement in crates/worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/*tests.rs, crates/worth-topo/src/validation/tests.rs, scoped compile-fail public facade contract patterns, and the workspace Rust line-cap script scripts/ci/check_workspace_rust_line_caps.sh plus allowlist. First hard break: add focused certification tests before broad implementation: (1) adversarial discovery rejects unclassified static validator/invariant/category entry, (2) disposition validator rejects keep-like old surfaces and blank replacement/removal triggers, (3) deletion facade audit rejects delete/collapse rows still exported, (4) composition test checks every touched Rust file is under 400 lines or explicitly allowlisted. Proof boundary: tests must execute against typed inventory APIs and real source manifests, not prose/doc links. Done when runnable command list is ready for the implement turn: focused worth-kernel gate tests plus cargo check for affected crates and the line-cap script. Blocker: any currently over-cap scoped file touched by implementation must be split before close unless an explicit allowlist entry already exists; current risk files include worth-kernel/src/query_graph_authority_gate/registry.rs at 381 lines and several scoped tests/files above 350 lines.

Authority/proof-bearing types and sealed constructors: inspect and edit crates/worth-topo/src/topology_operators/touched_graph_basis/{basis.rs,lowering.rs,vocabulary.rs,mod.rs}, query_workflow/workflow_artifacts.rs, query_workflow/workflow_handle_ext.rs, query_workflow/handle_impl.rs, and crates/worth-schema/src/data/authority. Establish a crate-owned admitted topology-intent product, e.g. TopologyOperatorTouchedBasisDeclaration<T>, that holds the canonical Query declaration plus TopologyTouchedGraphBasis and counters/digest, with private fields and construction only from admitted topology semantic intent. worth-schema remains vocabulary/digest/counter recipe only; no public projection traits, admission constructors, or type-name guards. First hard break: route all topology basis creation through the sealed product and keep raw TopologyTouchedGraphBasisInput pub(crate). Proof: compile-fail fixtures reject external construction from raw EntityId/RelationId, mutation records, copied descriptors, raw rows, and copied spatial receipt fields. Adapter purge note: do not add a raw-declaration-to-basis wrapper; delete or keep crate-private any lowerer that accepts TopologyRewireLoopEndpointDeclaration/TopologySpliceRadialAdjacencyDeclaration directly and prove it is unreachable from facade. Blocker for residue only if Worth Query cannot carry touch descriptors without API work; if so, record Query/runtime gap owned by worth-query with cap, removal trigger, and facade compile-fail denial.

Operator/request intent lowering: inspect and edit query_workflow/{workflow_handle_ext.rs,handle_impl.rs,workflow_artifacts.rs,grouped_and_contribution_builders.rs,retained_contribution_semantics.rs}, declaration_entry/scalar and grouped declarations, and application/declaration_entry/mutation_payload.rs. Establish the transition admitted topology operator intent -> declared topology touched graph basis before declare/review/progress/route/receipt/envelope/contribution methods can run. First hard break: replace methods that currently accept I: WorthQueryDeclarationInput directly for execution paths with methods that accept the touched-basis declaration product, leaving raw declaration admission only as the first step that creates the proof. Differentiation test must show distinct rewire vs radial splice bases choose distinct validator/invalidation sets. Adapter purge note: topology_operator_contribution_workflow and topology_operator_signal_workflow are old fronts if they can run from raw I; default delete or require the touched-basis declaration. Keeping any raw-I method requires certification-only classification and tests proving it cannot produce Query route/application authority.

Query or runtime selection/admission: inspect query_workflow/handle_impl.rs, query_domain current-head handle surfaces, projection/runtime_boundary/query_runtime bindings, construction/query_native_boundary/{admission.rs,admitted_handoff.rs,compose_execution/*.rs}, and worth-query runtime/mutation/graph_composition call sites if touched. The proof boundary is that Query route, receipt, envelope, contribution composition, continuation preparation/execution, and graph obligation dispatch consume a touched-basis declaration or descriptor derived from it, not a mutation sequence or declaration alone. First hard break: insert basis descriptor production before self.declare/self.orchestrate_declaration_entry/self.orchestrate_* route calls, and deny if the descriptor cannot be derived from the basis. Proof: omission test denies a mutation outside declared touched basis before commit; structural scan shows no Query orchestration call in worth-topo production uses raw declaration authority without basis. Adapter purge note: TopologyOperatorWorkflowHandleExt pass-through methods are adapter-shaped; delete, rename, or narrow them so ordinary production cannot bypass basis. If Worth Query lacks descriptor attachment, record exact Query gap and keep only a non-authoritative checked diagnostic path.

Validators, invariants, and denial posture: inspect rejection_locality, loop_reconstruction_blueprint/{validator_row.rs,required_phase_2_validator_lanes.rs,registry.rs,proof_obligation.rs}, adoption/catalog, application/admission.rs, and local_rewrites validators. Establish validator selection from basis aspects/scopes/lifecycle/relation kinds and denial before commit for undeclared touched mutations. First hard break: make validator/invalidation selector functions accept TopologyTouchedGraphBasis or touched-basis declaration, not mutation family alone. Proof: differentiation test shows two bases produce different validator and invalidation sets; omission test attempts to apply a mutation relation/entity absent from basis and receives a specific denial before Query commit. Adapter purge note: blueprint proof-obligation and local guard residue are old proof-obligation surfaces; delete or constrain them to certification inventory, not authority.

Derived invalidation, dirty propagation, replay, undo, and transaction scope: inspect application/declared_mutation_artifact.rs, accepted_mutation_projection.rs, mutation_evidence.rs, declared mutation sequence/digest modules, query_workflow_tests, and construction compose_execution evidence. Establish that accepted mutation projections retain the touched-basis digest/counters and use them for invalidation and replay identity. First hard break: TopologyDeclaredMutationArtifact::from_receipt must require the touched-basis declaration and reject semantic projections whose mutation digest falls outside the declared basis. Proof: replay parity verifies same topology operator intent yields the same touched basis digest across replay/benign ordering while mutation sequence order cannot alter basis; omission test proves dirty propagation is denied for undeclared scope. Adapter purge note: mutation records and accepted mutation projections may feed evidence but cannot stand in as basis; delete any constructor that treats TopologyDeclaredMutationSequence or TopologyAcceptedMutationProjection as authority without a basis argument.

Evidence lookup, indexing, receipts, and ledger identity: inspect worth-spatial planar_boolean_edge_splitting split_edge_chain_ledger, split_replay_parity, loop_reconstruction request and loop_reconstruction_ledger, plus topology construction birth_synopsis/admitted_handoff. Establish that boolean stages may provide topology birth intent or source lineage inputs, but spatial geometry evidence receipts never lower to topology touched graph authority in Phase 3. First hard break: any topology-facing spatial handoff must produce a topology operator intent/birth synopsis that is then lowered by worth-topo to basis; copied receipt_identity text must not satisfy a topology basis API. Proof: boundary test scans production worth-topo modules for geometry-only/spatial receipt admission and proves no production lowerer admits spatial geometry evidence as topology authority; compile-fail fixture tries copied split ledger receipt fields as basis input and fails. First hard break: batch equivalence and contribution grouping must compare touched-basis digests/descriptors, not declaration family strings or mutation records alone. Proof: parity/benign ordering tests stay green, plus differentiation test proves non-equivalent bases do not share validator/invalidation sets. Adapter purge note: any command-batch equivalent touch descriptor built without a basis is an old convenience front and must be deleted or made test-only certification.

Public facade, diagnostics, counters, and closeout proof: inspect crates/worth-topo/src/facade.rs and topology_operators/facade.rs. Expose ordinary public APIs for touched-basis proof/status and descriptor diagnostics without raw constructors. Keep TopologyTouchedGraphBasis read-only and private-field; expose counters/digest/aspect/scope readers and a status/proof type created by admitted operator intent. First hard break: facade must not export basis-producing functions from raw declarations, spatial receipt admission, or internal inputs. Hard deletion/collapse of replaced surfaces: deletion targets are raw Query workflow pass-throughs in TopologyOperatorWorkflowHandleExt/handle_impl, topology_operator_contribution_workflow or signal_workflow paths that can bypass basis, retained application handoff constructors that accept contribution artifacts without basis, declared mutation artifact constructors that accept sequence/projection without basis, construction admitted handoff routes that treat birth receipt/handoff as topology authority, and any geometry-only/spatial receipt bridge found by rg. Proof: rg scan for adapter-shaped names and forbidden geometry/spatial admission patterns, plus compile-fail fixtures for old public routes. Adapter purge note: retained surfaces must be certification-only, capped residue, or Query gap with owner, cap, removal trigger, and denial test; otherwise they remain open findings.

Add lib/integration tests for differentiation, omission denial, replay/benign ordering parity, drift coverage for new topology touched aspect plus Query descriptor coverage, and boundary proof that production worth-topo does not lower spatial geometry evidence as topology authority. Run cargo check -p worth-topo -p worth-spatial -p worth-schema -p worth-query, targeted worth-topo touched basis/query workflow/application/construction tests, worth-spatial split/loop tests touched by birth intent, trybuild suites, rg structural scans, and scoped Rust line-cap scan against scripts/ci/workspace_rust_line_cap_allowlist.txt.
